newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil private coffee sector to meet Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: Brazil private coffee sector to meet Dec 16.

text.p: Brazilian private sector officials are to meet next week in a preparatory discussion ahead of a first session of the new coffee council, the CDPC, a soluble coffee industry association (ABICS) official said.
The meeting will take place Dec 16 at 1000 local/1200 GMT at the Sao Paulo headquarters of National Coffee Council which represents growers, said Mauro Malta, executive secretary of ABICS.

"It's an informal meeting of those members of the private sector which make up the coffee council. We are going to discuss the council and try to pressure the government to install the council formally," Malta said.

CDPC, which has a president and 12 members -- six from the private sector and six from the government -- was announced by President Fernando Henrique Cardoso in October and will be the forum for deciding future Brazilian coffee policy.
As yet, however, no date has been set for the first session of the council, and the private sector is anxious for the group to meet as soon as possible.
